senses.gloss: m. (רשב, cmp. רשף, v. נִשְׁבִּים) trap; trnsf. (sub. בעל) fowler; also surname of a family, Rishba.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 130a:10">Sabb. 130ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chullin 116a:15">Ḥull. 116ᵃ</cite> <he>יוסף ר׳</he> Joseph the fowler.—
<cite ref="Shabbat 146b:8">Sabb. 146ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Taanit 10a:13">Taan. 10ᵃ</cite> Taboth Rishba (the fowler, Rashi; oth. opin. = <he>ריש בי אבא</he> chief of the family).

<cite ref="Bava Batra 126b:3">B. Bath. 126ᵇ</cite> <he>מר זוטרא מדר׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>מר בר רושבא</he>; Ms. H. <he>מידרוּשְׁבָּנָא</he>; Ms. R. <he>מדרשיכא</he>; Alf. <he>מדרישכא</he>; Ms. Alf. <he>מדרישבא</he>) Mar Zutra of the house of R.
